# Example App Privacy Policy

This policy explains what Example App does with your data.

## Data we collect

### Location

We use your location to show nearby places.

| Data type | Purpose | Shared with |
|-----------|:--------|------------:|
| Email address | Account sign-in | Nobody |
| Device ID | Advertising | **Ad networks** |
| Precise location | [Maps](https://example.test/maps) | |
